name: Dubai
summary: Modern landmarks, desert experiences, family attractions and corporate event possibilities.
guidance: Consider hotel location, peak-season pricing, transfer timing and tour capacity.

hotelGuidance: Match hotel choice to route: Deira/Bur Dubai for value-led city stays, Downtown for landmarks, Marina/JBR for beach-access leisure, Palm for resort luxury.
operationalNotes: Check attraction slots, seasonal timings, drive times, public holidays, tourism fees, and SIC pickup windows. Seasonal gardens need calendar checks.
destinationOverview: From contemporary landmarks and desert adventures to family entertainment, luxury stays and corporate programmes, Dubai offers compelling itineraries for many traveller profiles.
planningHeadline: Good itineraries begin with realistic routing.
planningNote: Consider seasonal heat, attraction slot availability, event-date hotel demand and the distinction between SIC and private transfers.

name: Thailand
summary: Varied combinations of Bangkok, Pattaya, Phuket and Krabi, for different traveller styles.
guidance: Check regional flight routing, sea conditions, seasonal closures and transfer feasibility.

areaProfiles.advantages: Urban hotels, dining, shopping and day tours
areaProfiles.considerations: Traffic can affect sightseeing schedules

areaProfiles.advantages: Family shows and convenient resort-style city stays

standardExperiences: Nong Nooch Garden and cultural shows

hotelGuidance: Select Sukhumvit or riverside Bangkok according to touring needs; in Phuket, compare Patong, Kata/Karon and quieter resort zones. Avoid assuming all properties offer the same beach access.
operationalNotes: Separate land transfers from domestic flights and sea excursions; boat tours are weather-sensitive. For wildlife venues, apply responsible animal welfare standards.
destinationOverview: Thailand combines energetic cities, island stays, nature-led excursions, nightlife, wellness and family-friendly experiences across different travel styles.
planningHeadline: Good itineraries begin with realistic routing.
planningNote: Choose logical city combinations. Explain domestic flights, speedboat dependence on weather and transfer durations clearly.

destinationOverview: Bali is suited to romantic escapes, private villas, wellness-led programmes, waterfall and temple experiences, and curated adventure.
planningHeadline: Good itineraries begin with realistic routing.
planningNote: Traffic can considerably affect transfer times. Match hotel location to the experience mix and allow buffers for island excursions.

summary: Island stays, romantic villa experiences and premium relaxation.
guidance: Confirm resort transfer mode, domestic/seaplane schedules, meal plans, taxes and flight arrival times.

areaProfiles.advantages: Convenient speedboat-resort choices
areaProfiles.considerations: Resorts vary significantly in price and style

areaProfiles.advantages: Resort diversity and marine excursions
areaProfiles.considerations: Transfers can add cost or time

standardExperiences: Sunset cruise / dolphin watching where available
Private beach dining as an upgrade
Guided water activities with safety oversight
offbeatIdeas: Local island cultural experiences where appropriate
Split-stay beach and water villa combination
hotelGuidance: Compare resort island vs local island; beach villa vs water villa; meal plan (BB/HB/FB/AI); reef, child policy, location, and transfer method. Quote full transfer and taxes.
operationalNotes: Resort access uses speedboat, seaplane or domestic flight plus boat depending on location. Confirm flight arrival, daylight-only seaplane schedules, meal plan, green tax and marine weather before quoting.
destinationHeadline: A world of islands, designed around your guests.
destinationOverview: Maldives programmes begin with the right island, resort, meal plan and villa category. Add water experiences and special-occasion touches to match the guest profile.
planningHeadline: Good itineraries begin with realistic routing.
planningNote: Resort transfer type and meal plan shape the quotation. Confirm speedboat, seaplane or domestic-flight routing against guest arrival time and the specific resort.
